l08-salade-poulet-avocat-oeuf.t: Chicken, Avocado and Soft-Boiled Egg Main Salad
s: Season the chicken with paprika, cumin, salt and pepper, then cook it in 1 tbsp of the oil for 5–6 min per side. Let it rest and slice.
Cook the eggs in boiling water for 6 min 30 s, then cool them immediately and peel carefully.
Dry-toast the pumpkin seeds in a skillet for 2 min.
Toss the arugula and diced cucumber with the remaining oil, the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Add the sliced avocado, the chicken, the halved eggs and the pumpkin seeds.
l08-salade-poulet-avocat-oeuf.p: Squeeze lemon over the avocado if it has to wait: it won't turn brown.

l08-jben-oeufs-brouilles-zaatar.t: Scrambled Eggs with Jben, Tomato and Za'atar
s: Cut the tomato into small cubes and pat them dry.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt the butter over low heat, pour in the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula for 3–4 min until you get creamy curds.
Off the heat, fold in the crumbled jben and the tomato.
Serve drizzled with olive oil and sprinkled with za'atar.
l08-jben-oeufs-brouilles-zaatar.p: Take the eggs off the heat while they are still a little runny: the residual heat finishes the cooking.

l08-salade-thon-avocat-oeufs-mimosa.t: Tuna, Avocado and Mimosa Egg Main Salad
i: can of tuna in water, drained
s: Cook the eggs in boiling water for 10 min, cool and peel them.
Halve the eggs, remove the yolks and mash them with a fork with the mayonnaise and half of the chives.
Mix the flaked tuna with the chopped pickles, the lemon juice and pepper.
Fill the egg whites with the yolk-mayonnaise mixture.
Arrange the salad dressed with olive oil, add the tuna, the sliced avocado and the mimosa eggs, then sprinkle with the remaining chives.
l08-salade-thon-avocat-oeufs-mimosa.p: Prepare the hard-boiled eggs the day before: they keep 4 days in the fridge in their shell.

s: Cook the eggs in boiling water for 10 min, cool and peel them.
Melt the ghee, add the chopped onion and cook for 4 min, then the garlic and ginger for 1 min.
Add the spices, stir for 30 s, then pour in the tomatoes and let reduce for 5 min.
Stir in the coconut cream and the spinach, add salt and cook for 4 min until the spinach has wilted.
Lightly score the eggs with a cross so they absorb the sauce, add them and simmer for 3 min.
Sprinkle with cilantro and serve.
l08-curry-oeufs-epinards.p: Serve with cauliflower rice or konjac rice for a complete meal.

l08-chou-fleur-gratine-cheddar.t: Cauliflower Gratin with Cheddar and Eggs
s: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Cut the cauliflower into florets.
Cook them for 8 min in salted boiling water (they should stay a little firm), then drain very well.
Heat the cream with the cream cheese, mustard and two thirds of the cheddar until everything has melted; off the heat, add the beaten eggs, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Butter a baking dish, arrange the cauliflower and cover with the sauce.
Sprinkle with the remaining cheddar and bake for 25 min until the top is golden.
l08-chou-fleur-gratine-cheddar.p: Budget version: replace the cheddar with grated edam.

s: If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 20 min.
Cut the halloumi, zucchini, bell pepper and onion into 2.5 cm cubes; leave the mushrooms whole.
Mix the oil, lemon juice, oregano, paprika and pepper; coat the cubes with it.
Thread the skewers, alternating cheese and vegetables.
Grill them for 10–12 min under the broiler, on a griddle or on the barbecue, turning regularly.
Serve with the Greek yogurt mixed with chopped mint.
l08-halloumi-brochettes-legumes.p: Halloumi doesn't melt when cooked, which makes it ideal for the barbecue.

l08-poivrons-farcis-ricotta-epinards.t: Bell Peppers Stuffed with Ricotta, Spinach and Parmesan
s: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Cut the peppers in half lengthwise and remove the seeds.
Wilt the spinach with the garlic in the oil for 3 min, then drain, pressing out the liquid, and chop.
Mix the ricotta, eggs, Parmesan, spinach, chopped basil, salt and pepper.
Fill the pepper halves and place them in an oiled dish.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 20 min, then remove the foil, sprinkle with mozzarella and continue for 15 min.
Serve when the cheese is golden and the peppers are tender.
l08-poivrons-farcis-ricotta-epinards.p: Red peppers are sweeter: to cut carbs, use green peppers.

l08-salade-tiede-chevre-noix.t: Warm Goat Cheese Salad with Walnuts and Poached Egg
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Place the goat cheese slices on parchment paper and sprinkle with almond flour and thyme.
Bake for 6–8 min until the cheese is soft and lightly golden.
Meanwhile, bring a pan of water to a gentle simmer with 1 tbsp of vinegar, create a whirlpool and poach each egg for 3 min.
Make the vinaigrette with the mustard, the remaining vinegar, the oil, salt and pepper; dress the mesclun.
Arrange the salad, add the crushed walnuts, the warm goat cheese and the drained poached egg.
l08-salade-tiede-chevre-noix.p: Crack each egg into a small cup before sliding it into the water: poaching is easier.

l08-tajine-legumes-oeufs-olives.t: Vegetable Tajine with Eggs and Olives
s: In a tajine or a deep skillet, cook the sliced onion in the oil for 4 min.
Add the spices, the grated tomato and 100 ml of water, then the zucchini and bell pepper cut into sticks. Add salt.
Cover and simmer for 15 min over low heat.
Add the olives and the preserved lemon cut into strips, then crack the eggs over the vegetables.
Cover and cook for 6–8 min until the whites are set.
Crumble the jben, sprinkle with herbs and serve in the tajine.
l08-tajine-legumes-oeufs-olives.p: Use a heat diffuser under a clay tajine to keep it from cracking on the stove.

l08-salade-poulet-tahini-chou.t: Chicken Salad with Crunchy Cabbage and Tahini Dressing
s: Season the chicken with cumin, paprika and salt, then cook it in 1 tbsp of the oil for 5–6 min per side. Let it rest, then shred or slice.
Thinly slice both cabbages, dice the cucumber and chop the parsley.
Make the dressing: whisk the tahini, lemon juice, grated garlic, a pinch of salt and 3–4 tbsp of cold water until smooth.
Toss the vegetables with the remaining oil and half of the dressing.
Add the chicken and drizzle with the rest of the tahini dressing.
l08-salade-poulet-tahini-chou.p: Dressed cabbage keeps 3 days: prepare three lunch boxes at once.

l08-mini-quiches-brocoli-emmental.t: Crustless Broccoli and Emmental Mini Quiches
s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and butter 12 cups of a muffin tin.
Cook the small broccoli florets in boiling water for 3 min, drain and roughly chop.
Beat the eggs with the cream, three quarters of the Emmental, salt and pepper.
Divide the broccoli and diced bell pepper among the cups, fill them three quarters full with the egg mixture and sprinkle with the remaining Emmental.
Bake for 20–22 min until puffed and golden; let cool for 5 min before unmolding.
l08-mini-quiches-brocoli-emmental.p: They keep 4 days in the fridge and can be frozen: perfect for kids' snacks and lunch boxes.

l08-brouillade-tofu-legumes-curcuma.t: Tofu Scramble with Vegetables and Turmeric
s: Drain the tofu and crumble it coarsely with a fork.
Cook the diced bell pepper and the scallion in the oil for 3 min over medium heat.
Add the tofu, turmeric, cumin, salt and pepper, and cook for 5 min, stirring, until it browns slightly.
Stir in the spinach and let it wilt for 1 min.
Serve hot with the sliced avocado.
l08-brouillade-tofu-legumes-curcuma.p: A pinch of black salt (kala namak) gives the scramble a real egg flavor.

l08-pizza-chou-fleur-champignons.t: Cauliflower-Crust Pizza with Mushrooms and Olives
s: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Process the cauliflower into rice-sized crumbs, microwave for 5 min and let cool slightly.
Squeeze it out very hard in a clean kitchen towel: it should be almost dry.
Mix it with the egg, 75 g of grated mozzarella, the Parmesan, oregano and a pinch of salt.
Spread the dough into a 28 cm disc, 5 mm thick, on parchment paper; bake for 15 min until golden.
Spread on the tomato sauce, add the sliced mozzarella, the rest of the grated mozzarella, the sliced mushrooms and the olives.
Return to the oven for 10–12 min, then drizzle with olive oil before serving.
l08-pizza-chou-fleur-champignons.p: Don't overload the crust and pre-bake it well: that's what makes it crisp.

l08-salade-crevettes-avocat-concombre.t: Shrimp, Avocado and Cucumber Main Salad
s: Cook the eggs for 9 min, cool and peel them.
Sauté the shrimp in 1 tbsp of the oil with the chopped garlic and chili for 2–3 min over high heat, until pink.
Dice the avocado and cucumber, chop the cilantro.
Whisk the remaining oil with the lemon juice and salt.
Toss the salad greens, avocado, cucumber and dressing, then add the warm shrimp and the quartered eggs.
l08-salade-crevettes-avocat-concombre.p: If using frozen shrimp, thaw them the day before in the fridge and dry them well before searing.

l08-halloumi-harissa-epinards.t: Pan-Fried Harissa Halloumi on Garlic Spinach
s: Cut the halloumi into 6 slices and brush them with the harissa thinned with 1 tsp of oil.
Cook the sliced garlic in 1 tbsp of oil for 1 min, add the spinach and wilt for 3 min; sprinkle with lemon juice, season with pepper and divide among the plates.
In the same pan, fry the eggs in the remaining oil.
Sear the halloumi for 1–2 min per side over high heat until caramelized.
Place the halloumi and eggs on the spinach and sprinkle with toasted pumpkin seeds.
l08-halloumi-harissa-epinards.p: Adjust the harissa to your family's taste; for children, replace it with sweet paprika.

l08-zaalouk-oeufs-gratines.t: Zaalouk Eggplant Salad with Baked Eggs
s: Peel the eggplants in alternating strips and cut into cubes. Steam them or cook in salted boiling water for 10 min, then drain.
In an oven-safe skillet, heat the oil, add the grated tomato, chopped garlic, cumin and paprika; cook for 3 min.
Add the eggplants and mash them with a fork; cook for 12–15 min, stirring, until the zaalouk is thick and jammy. Add salt, the herbs and the lemon juice.
Preheat the oven to broil. Make 5 wells in the zaalouk and crack the eggs into them.
Cover and cook for 4 min on the stove, then sprinkle with edam and broil for 3 min.
l08-zaalouk-oeufs-gratines.p: Zaalouk keeps 4 days in the fridge: make a double batch and serve the rest cold as a side.

l08-tofu-marine-salade-concombre-sesame.t: Grilled Marinated Tofu with Sesame Cucumber Salad
s: Press the tofu for 10 min and cut it into 6 thick slices.
Mix the soy sauce, ginger, grated garlic and 1 tbsp of oil; marinate the tofu for 15 min, turning it.
Cut the cucumber into thin rounds and toss it with the vinegar, erythritol, chili, a pinch of salt and half of the sesame.
Grill the tofu slices in a hot skillet with the remaining oil for 3–4 min per side, brushing with the marinade.
Serve the tofu on the cucumber salad, sprinkled with scallion and the rest of the sesame.
l08-tofu-marine-salade-concombre-sesame.p: You can marinate in the morning: the tofu will be even more flavorful in the evening.

s: Whisk the ricotta with the eggs, erythritol and vanilla until smooth.
Add the almond flour and baking powder; mix without overworking. Let rest for 5 min.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat with a little butter.
Pour in small ladlefuls of batter (8 cm), cook for 2–3 min until bubbles appear, flip gently and cook for 1–2 min.
Serve with the Greek yogurt and raspberries.
l08-pancakes-ricotta-framboises.p: These pancakes are delicate: keep them small and flip them with a wide spatula.

l08-crepes-jben-epinards.t: Keto Crepes Filled with Jben and Spinach
s: Blend the eggs, cream cheese, almond flour and psyllium; let rest for 5 min.
In a lightly buttered 20 cm skillet over medium heat, make 6 thin crepes: 1–2 min per side. Stack them.
Wilt the spinach with the scallion in a little butter for 3 min, drain, pressing out the liquid, season lightly with salt and add the cumin.
Mix the spinach with the crumbled jben and pepper.
Fill each crepe, roll it up and arrange them in a baking dish; sprinkle with mozzarella.
Bake for 8–10 min at 200 °C until the cheese is golden and bubbly.
l08-crepes-jben-epinards.p: Plain crepes keep 3 days in the fridge, separated by parchment paper.

l08-courgettes-farcies-chevre-menthe.t: Zucchini Stuffed with Goat Cheese, Mint and Egg
s: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Cut the zucchini in half lengthwise and scoop them out with a spoon, leaving 5 mm of flesh.
Chop the scooped-out flesh and cook it for 5 min in 1 tbsp of oil with the garlic; let cool.
Mix it with the goat cheese, eggs, half of the Parmesan, chopped mint, salt and pepper.
Salt the inside of the zucchini boats, fill them and place them in an oiled dish.
Sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan and the sliced almonds, then bake for 25–30 min until the filling is golden.
l08-courgettes-farcies-chevre-menthe.p: Replace the goat cheese with jben for a milder version that kids love.

l08-salade-poulet-tandoori-raita.t: Tandoori Chicken Salad with Cucumber Raita
s: Mix 80 g of yogurt with the tandoori spices, grated garlic, lemon juice and salt; coat the chicken and marinate for at least 30 min (ideally overnight).
Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Place the chicken on an oiled baking sheet and bake for 18–20 min, then broil for 2 min to brown it.
Make the raita: grate the cucumber, squeeze it dry and mix it with the remaining yogurt, chopped mint and a pinch of salt.
Cut the lettuce and red onion into thin strips.
Slice the chicken and serve it on the salad, topped with the raita.
l08-salade-poulet-tandoori-raita.p: Marinated chicken can be frozen raw: take it out the day before for a dinner ready in 20 min.

l08-asperges-oeufs-mollets-parmesan.t: Green Asparagus with Soft-Boiled Eggs and Parmesan
s: Snap off the tough base of the asparagus where it bends naturally.
Cook the eggs in boiling water for 6 min 30 s, cool them in ice water and peel.
Cook the asparagus in the oil over medium-high heat for 6–8 min, rolling them, until tender and browned; add salt.
Melt the butter until it turns nutty, then add the lemon juice.
Arrange the asparagus, place the opened eggs on top, drizzle with the brown butter and sprinkle with Parmesan and hazelnuts.
l08-asperges-oeufs-mollets-parmesan.p: When asparagus is out of season, the recipe works with green beans or broccoli.

s: Cut the halloumi into 2 cm cubes and brown them in 1 tbsp of ghee for 4–5 min; set aside.
Cook the chopped onion in the remaining ghee for 4 min, then the garlic and ginger for 1 min.
Add the spices, stir for 30 s, pour in the tomatoes and let reduce for 5 min.
Add the cauliflower in small florets, the green beans cut into pieces and 100 ml of water; cover and cook for 10 min.
Pour in the cream, add the spinach and the halloumi, and simmer for 3 min. Taste before salting: halloumi is already salty.
Sprinkle with cilantro and serve.
l08-curry-legumes-paneer-halloumi.p: Halloumi is a great substitute for Indian paneer, which is hard to find in Morocco, and it holds its shape in the sauce.

l08-cake-sale-olives-feta.t: Savory Loaf Cake with Olives, Feta and Herbs
s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and line a loaf pan with parchment paper.
Beat the eggs with the oil and the Greek yogurt.
Add the almond flour, baking powder and pepper, and mix until the batter is smooth.
Fold in the diced feta, the sliced olives, the Emmental and the chopped herbs.
Pour into the pan and bake for 40 min: a knife tip should come out dry.
Let cool for 15 min before unmolding and slicing.
l08-cake-sale-olives-feta.p: Sliced, it freezes very well; perfect for appetizers or snacks.

l08-salade-thon-haricots-verts-oeuf.t: Warm Green Bean, Tuna and Mustard Egg Salad
i: cans of tuna in oil, drained
s: Cook the eggs for 9 min, cool and peel them.
Cook the green beans for 7–8 min in salted boiling water; they should stay slightly crisp. Drain.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar, oil, salt and pepper; add the very thinly sliced red onion.
Pour the vinaigrette over the still-warm beans so they soak it up.
Add the tuna in chunks, the quartered eggs and the chopped parsley.
l08-salade-thon-haricots-verts-oeuf.p: Served warm or cold, it travels very well in a lunch box.

l08-omelette-espagnole-chou-fleur.t: Spanish Tortilla with Cauliflower and Bell Pepper
s: Cut the cauliflower into thin 5 mm slices and pre-cook it for 5 min in a steamer.
In a 24 cm nonstick skillet, cook the sliced onion and bell pepper in 2 tbsp of oil for 5 min, add the cauliflower and brown for 5 min.
Beat the eggs with the Emmental, paprika, parsley, salt and pepper; pour over the vegetables.
Cook for 8 min over low heat, with the lid on, loosening the edges with a spatula.
Flip the tortilla using a plate, add the remaining oil and cook for another 3–4 min.
Let cool for 5 min and cut into wedges.
l08-omelette-espagnole-chou-fleur.p: Also delicious cold the next day, cut into cubes, for appetizers or a picnic.

l08-salade-roquette-halloumi-avocat-grai.t: Arugula, Halloumi, Avocado and Seed Salad
s: Cook the eggs for 8 min, cool and peel them.
Dry-toast the seeds for 2 min in a skillet; set aside.
Cut the halloumi into sticks and brown them for 1–2 min per side in the same very hot pan.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice, mustard and pepper.
Toss the arugula with the vinaigrette, add the sliced avocado, the quartered eggs, the hot halloumi and the seeds.
l08-salade-roquette-halloumi-avocat-grai.p: In summer, add a few sliced strawberries for a sweet-and-salty touch.

l08-tofu-kefta-tomate-oeufs.t: Tofu Kefta-Spiced Meatballs in Tomato Sauce with Eggs
s: Press the tofu for 10 min in a kitchen towel, then crumble it finely.
Mix it with 1 egg, the almond flour, the Parmesan, half of the spices and of the chopped herbs, salt and pepper. Shape into 16 balls.
Brown them in 2 tbsp of oil for 6–8 min, turning gently; set aside.
In a tajine or deep skillet, cook the chopped onion and garlic in the remaining oil, add the rest of the spices and the tomatoes; simmer for 8 min.
Add the balls, crack the remaining 4 eggs into the sauce, cover and cook for 6–7 min.
Sprinkle with the remaining herbs and serve piping hot.
l08-tofu-kefta-tomate-oeufs.p: Inspired by the classic kefta tajine with eggs, this one is fully vegetarian and high in protein.

l08-salade-dinde-fumee-chou-noix.t: Crunchy Smoked Turkey, Cabbage and Walnut Salad
s: Very thinly slice the white cabbage and salt it lightly; leave for 10 min, then squeeze it to soften.
Mix the mayonnaise, yogurt, mustard, salt and pepper.
Cut the smoked turkey into strips and the pickles into rounds.
Combine the cabbage, turkey, Emmental, pickles and dressing.
Sprinkle with crushed walnuts and chives just before serving.
l08-salade-dinde-fumee-chou-noix.p: No cooking needed: a perfect idea for busy evenings or a lunch at the office.

l08-gratin-aubergines-feta-menthe.t: Eggplant Gratin with Feta and Eggs
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the eggplants into 1 cm rounds, brush them with oil and roast for 20 min.
Beat the eggs with the yogurt, grated garlic, cumin, chopped mint and pepper.
Arrange the eggplant in a dish, overlapping the slices, and sprinkle with crumbled feta.
Pour in the egg mixture and sprinkle with Emmental.
Lower the oven to 180 °C and bake for 20 min, until set and golden.
l08-gratin-aubergines-feta-menthe.p: The yogurt makes the custard light and tangy: it's the spirit of a vegetarian moussaka.

l08-poke-bowl-thon-konjac.t: Marinated Tuna Bowl with Konjac Rice and Avocado
s: Cut the tuna into 1.5 cm cubes and marinate for 10 min in the fridge with the soy sauce, oil, ginger and lime juice.
Rinse the konjac rice thoroughly, boil it for 2 min, then dry it for 3 min in a hot skillet with no fat.
Dice the avocado and cucumber, slice the scallion into rounds and cut the nori into thin strips.
Divide the konjac between two bowls and add the marinated tuna, avocado and cucumber.
Sprinkle with sesame, scallion and nori, and drizzle with the rest of the marinade.
l08-poke-bowl-thon-konjac.p: The tuna must be sashimi-grade; otherwise, sear it for 30 s per side before cutting it.

l08-feta-rotie-legumes-oeufs.t: Baked Feta with Sun-Ripened Vegetables and Eggs
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the zucchini and bell pepper into 2 cm pieces.
Put the vegetables, cherry tomatoes, olives and sliced garlic in a dish, drizzle with oil, add the herbs and pepper; toss.
Place the block of feta in the center and bake for 20 min.
Take the dish out, make 4 wells between the vegetables and crack the eggs into them.
Return to the oven for 8–10 min until the whites are set.
Gently mash the feta into the vegetables, sprinkle with basil and serve.
l08-feta-rotie-legumes-oeufs.p: A hands-off one-dish meal: everything cooks in the same dish, so there is very little washing up.

l09-harira-keto-poulet.t: Keto Harira with Chicken and Celery
s: In a large pot, melt the smen over medium heat and cook the grated onion for 3 min.
Add the diced chicken, the spices, salt and pepper; stir for 4 min until the chicken turns white.
Add the finely sliced celery, half of the cilantro and parsley, the crushed tomatoes and the paste diluted in a little broth.
Pour in the broth, bring to a boil, then simmer covered for 35 min over low heat.
Briefly blend a ladleful of vegetables and return it to the soup to thicken it (this replaces the flour).
Off the heat, drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring gently with a fork to form strands.
Add the rest of the herbs and the lemon juice, adjust the seasoning and serve piping hot.
l09-harira-keto-poulet.p: Ideal for the Ramadan ftour (iftar): serve with a few dates for the non-keto members of the family. Freezes for 2 months without the eggs.

s: Melt the butter in a pot and sweat the onion for 3 min without browning.
Add the cumin and toast for 30 s, stirring.
Add the cauliflower florets and the broth, bring to a boil, then cook for 20 min covered.
Blend until smooth, adding the cream, to get a velvety texture; season with salt and pepper.
Serve sprinkled with chives and a pinch of cumin.
l09-veloute-chou-fleur-cumin.p: For a more filling soup, add pan-fried diced turkey kachir (deli-style turkey) when serving.

l09-veloute-courgette-fromage-frais.t: Zucchini Soup with Cream Cheese and Basil
s: Heat the oil in a pot and cook the crushed garlic for 1 min.
Add the unpeeled zucchini and stir for 3 min over high heat.
Pour in the broth (it should just cover), add salt and cook for 15 min.
Add the cream cheese and the basil leaves, then blend until smooth.
Adjust the seasoning and serve hot, or cold in summer.
l09-veloute-courgette-fromage-frais.p: Don't add too much broth: zucchini release a lot of water. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

s: Melt the butter and sweat the onion for 3 min.
Add the broccoli (including the stems, peeled and diced) and the broth; cook covered for 15 min.
Set aside a few small florets for garnish, then blend the rest coarsely.
Return to low heat, add the cream and mustard, then the cheddar by handfuls, stirring until melted, without letting it boil.
Add the reserved florets, season with pepper and serve immediately.
l09-soupe-brocoli-cheddar.p: Never let it boil after adding the cheese, or it will turn stringy. A little leftover shredded chicken makes it a complete dinner.

l09-chorba-boeuf-celeri-navet.t: Beef Chorba with Celery and Turnip
s: In a Dutch oven, melt the smen and sear the beef for 5 min with the onion.
Add the spices, salt, pepper and grated tomato; stir for 2 min.
Pour in the water, bring to a boil, skim, then simmer covered for 60 min (or 25 min in a pressure cooker).
Add the diced turnip and celery and continue cooking for 25 min until the turnip is tender.
Add the cilantro at the end of cooking and adjust the salt. Serve piping hot.
l09-chorba-boeuf-celeri-navet.p: Turnip replaces potato without blowing up the carbs. Make a big batch: chorba is even better reheated.

l09-soupe-thai-crevettes-coco.t: Thai Shrimp and Coconut Milk Soup
s: In a pot, bring the broth to a simmer with the ginger, crushed garlic and sliced chili; let infuse for 5 min.
Add the coconut milk and mushrooms, and simmer for 5 min without boiling hard.
Add the shrimp and cook for 3 min, until they turn pink.
Off the heat, add the soy sauce and lime juice; taste and adjust the salt.
Serve in bowls sprinkled with fresh cilantro.
l09-soupe-thai-crevettes-coco.p: Frozen shrimp work fine: thaw them in the fridge the day before and pat them dry.

s: Clean and slice the mushrooms; set 4 aside for finishing.
Melt the butter, add the chopped onion and garlic and cook for 3 min.
Add the mushrooms and brown them for 8 min over high heat until their liquid has evaporated.
Pour in the broth and cook for 10 min, then blend with the cream; season with salt and pepper.
Quickly pan-fry the reserved sliced mushrooms and place them on each bowl with the parsley.
l09-veloute-champignons-ail.p: Browning the mushrooms well before adding the broth gives all the flavor: don't crowd them in the pot.

s: Snap off the tough base of the asparagus, cut off the tips and set them aside; cut the stalks into pieces.
Melt the butter and sweat the sliced leek for 4 min.
Add the asparagus stalks and the broth; cook covered for 15 min.
Meanwhile, cook the tips for 4 min in a little salted boiling water.
Blend the soup with the crème fraîche, season and serve topped with the tips.
l09-veloute-asperges.p: Out of season, frozen asparagus works very well for this soup.

s: Beat the eggs with the Parmesan, pepper and a pinch of salt.
In a pot, heat the oil, add the chopped garlic for 30 s, then pour in the broth; bring to a boil.
Add the spinach and let it wilt for 1 min.
Reduce to a simmer and drizzle in the egg-Parmesan mixture while stirring gently: it forms small ribbons.
Leave for 1 min without stirring, add the lemon juice and serve immediately.
l09-stracciatella-epinards.p: Ready in 15 minutes, it's the dinner for a rushed evening. Use homemade broth for more flavor.

l09-veloute-potiron-coco.t: Pumpkin and Cauliflower Soup with Coconut Milk
s: Heat the coconut oil and cook the onion and ginger for 3 min.
Add the pumpkin and cauliflower, and stir for 2 min.
Pour in the broth, add salt and cook for 20 min covered until the vegetables are very soft.
Add the coconut milk and blend until smooth; adjust the seasoning.
Serve sprinkled with pumpkin seeds dry-toasted for 2 min in a skillet.
l09-veloute-potiron-coco.p: Cauliflower lowers the carbs of the pumpkin while keeping its sweetness. Kids love the orange color.

s: Put the chicken in the cold broth with the halved onion, the garlic and the thyme and bay leaf; bring to a boil and skim.
Simmer for 25 min, then remove the chicken and shred it with a fork.
Add the sliced celery and the carrot to the broth and cook for 10 min.
Rinse the konjac noodles under cold water for 1 min, then dry them for 2 min in a skillet with no fat.
Return the chicken and add the noodles; heat for 3 min, season with salt and pepper and add the parsley.
l09-soupe-poulet-konjac.p: Rinsing and dry-frying remove the konjac smell. Comforting in winter or when a child has a cold.

l09-gaspacho-concombre-avocat.t: Green Gazpacho with Cucumber, Avocado and Mint
s: Peel the cucumbers in alternating strips, remove the seeds and cut into pieces.
Put the cucumbers, avocado flesh, yogurt, mint, garlic and lemon juice in the blender.
Blend for 1 min, adding the cold water until you reach the desired consistency; season with salt and pepper.
Chill for at least 30 min and serve with a drizzle of olive oil and a few mint leaves.
l09-gaspacho-concombre-avocat.p: Perfect in hot weather. Eat it the same day, as avocado turns brown.

s: Peel the celeriac with a knife and cut it into 2 cm cubes.
Cook the celeriac and cauliflower in the butter for 3 min.
Add the broth, salt and cook for 25 min covered.
Meanwhile, dry-toast the hazelnuts for 3 min in a skillet, then chop them.
Blend the soup with the cream and nutmeg; serve sprinkled with hazelnuts.
l09-veloute-celeri-rave-noisettes.p: Squeeze lemon over the peeled celeriac if it has to wait: it darkens quickly in the air.

s: Mix the kefta with half of the chopped herbs, half of the spices, salt and pepper; shape into walnut-sized meatballs.
In a pot, heat the oil and cook the onion for 3 min with the rest of the spices.
Add the crushed tomatoes and the water, and bring to a boil.
Gently lower in the meatballs and cook for 15 min at a simmer without stirring.
Add the diced zucchini and continue for 10 min.
Sprinkle with the remaining herbs and serve.
l09-soupe-kefta-courgettes.p: Shape the meatballs with wet hands so they don't stick. They can be frozen raw on a tray.

l09-veloute-epinards-jben.t: Spinach and Zucchini Soup with Jben
s: Cook the garlic in the oil for 1 min, then add the sliced zucchini for 3 min.
Add the broth and cook for 10 min.
Add the spinach and cook for another 5 min.
Blend with 100 g of jben and the nutmeg; season with salt and pepper.
Serve, crumbling the rest of the jben over each bowl.
l09-veloute-epinards-jben.p: Jben adds a pleasant tang; if you can't find it, use feta and reduce the salt.

s: Melt the butter and sweat the sliced leek and celery for 5 min.
Add the cauliflower and the broth, and cook for 12 min.
Blend a ladleful of the mixture with the cream and pour it back into the pot to thicken the soup.
Add the salmon in 3 cm cubes and poach for 5 min at a very gentle simmer.
Add the chopped dill, season with salt and pepper and serve right away.
l09-chaudree-saumon-aneth.p: Diced cauliflower stands in for the potato of the classic chowder. Don't let it boil after adding the salmon.

s: In a pot, heat the oil and brown the ground beef for 6 min, breaking it up.
Add the chopped onion and garlic and the spices, and stir for 2 min.
Add the sliced cabbage and stir until it begins to wilt.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and the broth, season with salt and pepper and simmer for 25 min covered.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve.
l09-soupe-chou-boeuf-hache.p: Keeps 4 days in the fridge and freezes very well in individual portions.

s: Slice the fennel bulbs, keeping a few green fronds for garnish.
Cook the onion and fennel in the oil for 5 min without browning.
Add the broth and cook for 20 min covered.
Blend with the cream and half of the Parmesan; season with pepper.
Serve with the rest of the Parmesan and the fennel fronds.
l09-veloute-fenouil-parmesan.p: Cooked fennel loses its strong anise flavor: even those who don't like it raw enjoy this soup.

s: Heat the oil in a pot and cook the ginger and the white part of the scallions for 1 min.
Add the mushrooms, stir for 3 min, then pour in the broth and soy sauce; bring to a simmer.
Add the tofu and heat for 5 min.
Drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring gently.
Serve sprinkled with the green part of the scallions, nori strips and sesame.
l09-soupe-tofu-champignons-gingembre.p: Choose a firm tofu that holds its shape when cooked. Add a little harissa for those who like it spicy.

s: Cut the cauliflower into florets and steam for 12 to 15 min, until a knife slides in without resistance.
Drain thoroughly and let it steam in the colander for 3 min to release the water.
Blend with the butter, crème fraîche and Parmesan until smooth.
Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg; serve hot.
l09-puree-chou-fleur-beurre.p: Steaming avoids a watery mash. Pairs perfectly with a roast or meatballs in sauce.

s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Wrap the unpeeled garlic cloves with a drizzle of oil in foil and roast for 25 min.
Meanwhile, cook the cubed celeriac and the cauliflower for 20 min in salted boiling water.
Drain well and squeeze the roasted garlic out of its skin.
Blend the vegetables, garlic, butter and hot cream; season generously with salt and pepper.
l09-puree-celeri-rave-ail-roti.p: The celeriac / cauliflower mix keeps the carbs low while giving a real mash texture.

s: Grate the cauliflower on the large holes of a grater or pulse it in a food processor until it forms rice-sized grains.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat and add the chopped garlic for 30 s.
Add the cauliflower and sauté for 5 to 6 min, stirring, uncovered, until tender but still firm.
Off the heat, add the chopped herbs and the lemon juice; season with salt and pepper.
l09-riz-chou-fleur-saute.p: Don't cover the pan, or the rice will turn mushy. Raw grated cauliflower can be frozen flat in a bag.

s: Pulse the raw cauliflower in short bursts to get a very fine grain.
Steam the grains for 6 min in the top of the couscoussier.
Tip them into a large dish, add the smen, butter, salt and ras el hanout, then fluff with a fork.
Dry-toast the almonds for 2 min in a skillet and sprinkle them over the grains.
l09-semoule-chou-fleur-couscous.p: Serve it under a tajine or with the vegetables and meat of a Friday couscous: the broth flavors it.

s: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (convection) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel the celeriac and cut it into sticks 1 cm thick.
Toss the sticks with the oil, paprika and garlic powder.
Spread them out without overlapping and bake for 35 min, turning halfway through.
Salt when they come out of the oven and serve right away.
l09-frites-celeri-rave-four.p: With 500 g of celeriac the carbs stay reasonable: count one portion per person, no more. In an air fryer: 18 min at 200 °C.

s: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the zucchini into sticks, salt them and let them drain for 10 min, then pat dry.
Mix the Parmesan, almond flour and spices on a plate; beat the egg on another.
Dip each stick in the egg, then roll it in the breading.
Arrange on an oiled baking sheet, drizzle with oil and bake for 18 to 20 min until golden.
Serve with a yogurt-garlic sauce or mayonnaise.
l09-frites-courgette-parmesan.p: The draining step is essential to keep the breading crisp.

s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cook the cauliflower florets for 8 min in salted boiling water; drain thoroughly.
Butter a baking dish and arrange the cauliflower in it.
Whisk the cream, egg, mustard, half of the Emmental, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Pour over the cauliflower and sprinkle with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 25 to 30 min until the top is nicely golden.
l09-gratin-chou-fleur-emmental.p: Can be prepared the day before and browned at the last minute. Add diced turkey kachir (deli-style turkey) to make it a complete dish.
